metadata.description: Chromium suites for the viewer's SVG presentation, glTF batch pixels, section clipping and resize continuation. Named test:e2e so `nx affected -t test:e2e` selects them on the CI lane that installs Chromium.

Viewer parity references (Tau Brain research/nanoraster-viewer-parity-charter.md, W6): the production viewer's frame and camera per parity fixture, AO on and off, for tau-examples:test:viewer-parity. Software GPUs need TAU_E2E_WEBGPU_PROFILE=software and PARITY_HEADED=1 under xvfb-run; inputs are documented in the config.
